bull.t: Large Roche collaboration strengthens funding and commercialization capacity
bull.b: A major Roche alliance with $700M upfront and up to $2.3B in payments materially de-risks financing and grants Nurix access to Roche's development, manufacturing and global commercial infrastructure. This structurally accelerates late-stage programs and reduces sole-company execution burden.

bull.t: Differentiated Phase 1b data for BTK degrader supports clinical thesis
bull.b: Robust, reproducible response rates and favorable tolerability across cohorts validate the BTK degrader approach and support expanding indications. Durable clinical differentiation enhances the probability of registrational programs, strategic partnerships, and long-term competitive positioning vs existing BTK inhibitors.

bull.t: Recurring collaborator milestone revenue and optional co-development upside
bull.b: Milestone receipts from Sanofi and sizeable remaining milestone/royalty potential show the business model can generate non-dilutive, program-linked funding. The option to co-develop/co-promote adds strategic upside and a pathway to share commercialization economics without immediate product sales.

bear.t: Persistent high cash burn and negative free cash flow
bear.b: Sustained operating and free cash outflows near $300M TTM indicate heavy cash consumption to fund R&D and trials. Ongoing negative cash generation increases dependency on external financing or milestone receipts, elevating dilution and execution risk over the medium term.

bear.t: Sharp revenue decline and widening net losses
bear.b: A nearly 50% revenue drop combined with much larger losses reflects limited internal revenue offset to R&D spending. Structural operating deficits reduce runway and constrain reinvestment flexibility, raising the importance of milestone inflows or partner-funded development to sustain progress.

bear.t: No meaningful commercial product sales; revenue concentrated in collaborations
bear.b: Reliance on collaboration funding and milestones rather than product revenue makes long-term cash flow contingent on partner decisions and clinical outcomes. This structural revenue concentration creates binary program risk and variable funding timing that can impede sustained independent operations.
